reason_codes.no-outcome: Read the session's captured output; the ritual ended without printing an outcome line, so release the drive and re-drive.
reason_codes.malformed-outcome: The session's outcome line broke craft's grammar; read the session output, then release the drive and re-drive.
reason_codes.record-outside-spec: The session named a record outside this spec or vault; read the session output and the spec's slice record, then release the drive and re-drive.
reason_codes.record-unreadable: The record the session named could not be read from the vault; check it exists with lore record show, then release the drive and re-drive.
reason_codes.record-mismatch: The slice record's run block disagrees with the session's outcome; read the record's Unattended run block, then release the drive and re-drive.
reason_codes.ritual-stuck: The ritual reported itself stuck; read the record it names and its Unattended run block, fix the cause, then release the drive and re-drive.

drive_reason_codes.session-killed: The ritual session was ended before it finished; release the drive and re-drive.
drive_reason_codes.output-not-captured: The session's final output was not captured; read the session's own log, then release the drive and re-drive.
drive_reason_codes.outcome-unreadable: The command that judges the session outcome could not run; run trailhead doctor, then release the drive and re-drive.
drive_reason_codes.the execute leg is the next slice: The plan is ready and the drive stops here; the build runs as the next slice, so release the drive, then start it from the slice record.
drive_reason_codes.drive predates the loop: This drive began before the loop existed and cannot continue; release the drive, then start a new drive for the spec.
drive_reason_codes.refused: The ritual declined to run; read the reason in its output and the spec, fix the cause, then release the drive and re-drive.
drive_reason_codes.waiting: The ritual is waiting on something outside the loop; resolve it, then release the drive and re-drive.
drive_reason_codes.spec-complete: The spec has no slice left to choose; release the drive, then distill the spec.
drive_reason_codes.needs-a-decision: The ritual needs a decision only the operator can make; read the record it names, decide, then release the drive and re-drive.
drive_reason_codes.pr-ready: The slice is ready for a pull request; open it with portage, merge it, then release the drive and re-drive for the next slice.
drive_reason_codes.slice-chosen reported again on the plan: The plan session chose a slice instead of planning one; read its output to see why.
